title: The Signature Writing Archives Database — Overview: the archives of the writing system
body: Signature edition. Signature-curated archives with original Signature organization, labeled Signature throughout. A writing system that cannot keep its own products is a sieve. This database catalogs the seven archives that preserve everything the writing databases produce: templates, code snippets, documents, schemas, prompts, test corpora, and build artifacts. Each record describes one archive: its purpose, its contents, how to access it, how long items are kept, and how integrity is verified. The demo implements a working archive — add, retrieve, search, and audit — executed at build time.
capabilities: Catalog every archive in the writing system
Record archive contents and access methods
Track archive growth and integrity
Search archives by content
Preserve provenance for every archived item

title: The Signature Writing Archives Database — Writing Templates Archive
body: Signature edition. Signature-curated archives with original Signature organization, labeled Signature throughout. Archive: Writing Templates Archive. Reusable document templates for every writing category: emails, reports, proposals, scripts, and technical documents, each with slots, examples, and version history. Access: query by name, tag, or content hash; every item carries provenance and a verification record. Retention: items are locked once verified — only direct correction orders change them. Growth: the boundless generator extends each archive toward a million records, self-regulated with duplicate checks.
